content.value_statement: Database choices and schema changes are hard to compare before implementation. This skill gives context-based guidance for database selection, ORM choice, schema design, indexing, optimization, and migrations.
actual_capabilities: Compares PostgreSQL, Neon, Turso, SQLite, PlanetScale, and CockroachDB for application requirements.
Helps choose Drizzle, Prisma, Kysely, raw SQL, or SQLAlchemy by deployment and developer needs.
Explains normalization, primary keys, timestamps, relationships, and foreign key delete behavior.
Recommends index types, composite index order, and when to avoid over-indexing.
Guides N+1 analysis, EXPLAIN ANALYZE checks, JOIN usage, pagination, and caching.
Outlines safe migration patterns for adding, removing, renaming columns, and adding indexes.
limitations: Does not inspect a live database, workload, or production telemetry by itself.
Provides guidance, not a substitute for migration testing or DBA review.
The included validator focuses on Prisma schemas and has limited Drizzle validation.
Recommendations need adaptation to each team's hosting, scale, and compliance requirements.

use_cases.title: Choose a Stack
use_cases.description: Compare databases and ORMs for a new application before committing to infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Improve Schema Design
use_cases.description: Review table relationships, keys, timestamps, and indexes for a growing product.

use_cases.title: Plan Safer Migrations
use_cases.description: Break risky schema changes into deployable steps with rollback planning.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Database
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building [application]. Ask me any missing questions, then recommend a database and explain the trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Select an ORM
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare ORM options for [language or framework], [deployment target], and [team preference]. Recommend one option with risks.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Schema Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this planned data model: [describe entities and relationships]. Identify normalization, key, timestamp, and relationship issues.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Zero-Downtime Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a safe migration for [schema change] on [database]. Include deploy order, backfill strategy, indexes, and rollback concerns.

output_examples.input: Need a database for a local-first notes app with simple sync.
output_examples.output: SQLite fits the local use case. Consider Turso if edge replication becomes important later.

output_examples.input: A TypeScript edge app needs small bundle size and explicit query control.
output_examples.output: Drizzle is the best first choice. It keeps the bundle small and stays close to SQL.

output_examples.input: A production table needs a required customer status column.
output_examples.output: Add it nullable, backfill existing rows, deploy reads and writes, then enforce the constraint.

best_practices: Share deployment environment, query complexity, distribution needs, and team preferences before choosing tools.
Design indexes from actual filter, join, and sort patterns instead of guessing.
Test migrations on a data copy and keep a rollback plan for each release.
anti_patterns: Defaulting to PostgreSQL or Prisma without checking deployment context.
Adding indexes to every column without measuring read and write impact.
Making breaking schema changes in one deploy.

faq.question: Does this skill write database code?
faq.answer: It mainly guides design decisions. It can help draft schemas when asked, but you should validate them before production.

faq.question: Which databases does it compare?
faq.answer: It covers PostgreSQL, Neon, Turso, SQLite, PlanetScale, CockroachDB, and pgvector use cases.

faq.question: Can it help choose between Prisma and Drizzle?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares ORM choices by deployment target, bundle size, developer experience, and control needs.

faq.question: Does it support migration planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains safe steps for adding, removing, renaming, and indexing columns.

faq.question: Can it analyze a live production database?
faq.answer: No. It does not connect to databases or inspect live telemetry by itself.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Developers and technical leads who need practical database design guidance for application projects.
